description: Is there a compatible PyPI wheel for this Python and platform — Lists the wheels PyPI offers for a package release and picks those compatible with a given CPython version, OS, CPU architecture and libc (glibc or musl version, or macOS version), best match first, for agents choosing base images or debugging 'building from source' installs. Applies PEP 425/600/656 tag ordering, abi3, legacy manylinux aliases, Requires-Python and yanked files. CPython only (no Py

freeThreaded.description: Free-threaded build (cp313t): abi3 wheels do not apply.

arch.description: linux: x86_64 aarch64 i686 armv7l ppc64le s390x; macos: x86_64 arm64; windows: amd64 x86 arm64.

libcVersion.description: linux: glibc '2.28' or musl '1.2'. Without it only the linux_<arch> tag matches.

name: wheel-availability
